name: Heaven's Gate
caption: A stable built around Harvester of Sorrow and Hellkid Johnny Lords, renamed from Twisted Chaos after winning the promotion's own Stable Wars battle royal and absorbing four more wrestlers the same week.

tenures.source: Won the Stable Wars battle royal as Twisted Chaos on 9 February; renamed Heaven's Gate and expanded to eight members by the promotion's next broadcast, 15 February.
The EWWF's own 2 October, 10 October and 5 December 2002 Surrender broadcasts.

name: Old Breed
caption: A stable under the promotion's own owner, whose members lost the World Tag Team Championship, a United States Championship match, and the Extreme Championship across the record's own three broadcasts.

tenures.source: Farley Lane and Higor Rosa challenged for the World Tag Team Championship on 24 January; Mark Spencer and Farley Lane represented the stable in the Stable Wars battle royal on 9 February.

name: Family of Thugz
caption: The World Tag Team Champions throughout the record, managed by Todd Zuckerwise, who successfully defended the titles twice.

tenures.source: Retained the World Tag Team Championship on 24 January and again on 9 February.

name: Fourth Reich
caption: A stable led by the promotion's own Commissioner, FBK, whose Stable Wars entry ended when its own leader turned on his tag partner.

tenures.source: Kenneth Morlock and X-treme represented the stable in a World Title triangle match on 9 February; FBK and Simon Solkoff represented it in the Stable Wars battle royal the same night, where FBK eliminated his own partner.

name: War Ensemble
caption: A tag team that won its only match of the record before both members were absorbed into Heaven's Gate.

tenures.source: Won a tornado tag match over the Disfunctional Duo on 9 February; billed as part of Heaven's Gate by 15 February.

name: Lynch Mob
caption: A stable led by "Misfit" Chris Douvalas that stole the disputed World Heavyweight Championship belt outright, later recruiting Johnny Rotten after Luni's own departure for a rival stable.

tenures.source: Stole the World Heavyweight Championship belt during its own triangle match on 9 February; recruited Johnny Rotten to replace the departed Luni by 15 February.

name: Mighty Mighty Posers
caption: A tag team, loosely aligned with the Lynch Mob's own manager, that lost its only match of the record.

tenures.source: Lost a tag match to the Disfunctional Duo on 15 February.

name: Disfunctional Duo
caption: A tag team that split its two matches of the record, losing to War Ensemble before beating the Mighty Mighty Posers.

tenures.source: Lost to War Ensemble on 9 February; beat the Mighty Mighty Posers on 15 February.

name: Janitors Crew
caption: A tag team that challenged unsuccessfully for the World Tag Team Championship before its members went their separate ways in the ring.

tenures.source: Challenged the Family of Thugz for the World Tag Team Championship on 9 February, ending in the pair's own in-storyline arrest.
